ORDINANCE III OF 2001
An Ordinance to
amend the University of Balochistan Act, 1996
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 28th February, 2001]
No. Legis.1-4/Law/70-III,
dated 28-2-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 19th February, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may called the University of Balochistan
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 28th February, 2001]
No. Legis.1-4/Law/70-III,
dated 28-2-2001.--The following Ordinance made by the Governor of
Balochistan on 19th February, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:--
5. Amendment of section 13 of
Act III of 1996.---In the said Act, after section 13, the following new
sections shall be added:--
"13-A. Pro-Vice-Chancellor.--(1)
The Pro-Vice-Chancellor shall be appointed by Chancellor, on such terms and
conditions as the Chancellor may determine.
(2) At any time when the office
of the Vice-Chancellor is vacant or the Vice-Chancellor proceeds on official
tour or is absent or is unable to perform the functions of his office due to
illness or other reasons, the Pro -Vice-Chancellor will perform the duties of
the Vice-Chancellor.
13-B. Powers
and Duties of the Pro-Vice-Chancellor.--(1) The Pro Vice-Chancellor shall
assist the Vice-Chancellor in all University affairs. All matters requiring
orders, approval, sanction from the Vice-Chancellor shall be routed through the
Pro-Vice-Chancellor.
(2) The Pro-Vice-Chancellor shall
be ex officio member on all the Statutory Bodies of the University, such as
Senate, Syndicate, Academic Council, Finance and Planning Committee, Advance
Studies and Research Board, Selection Board and the Affiliation
Committee."
